use: Copy `cases` into a westack-eval routing campaign (kind routing) and register it before any description is tuned. The split is fixed here: score the held-out cases once per description version; scoring them against a changed description turns them into dev cases.
population_needed: Names in `expect` must be in the campaign's population: westack-plan, westack-build, westack-tdd, westack-review, westack-debug and westack-verify from this repository, plus the superpowers plugin's `superpowers:writing-plans`. the user's real population also holds gstack's spec, autoplan and plan-*-review skills and superpowers:writing-plans, the likeliest competitors for plan requests; keep them in. westack-spec is planned, not built: n06 carries `pending_until_built`, so leave it out of a campaign until that skill exists (its expectation stays; never relabel it), then delete the marker. westack-office-hours, which n07 expects, was built at alpha.50 and belongs in the population. Requests with no owner in the population expect NONE.
